title: What a Godly Man's Work Actually Looks Like
caption:
There's the work you'd do on camera and the work you'd do if the camera never showed up. Most men only train the first one.

The report nobody proofreads twice. The dish left in the sink at midnight. The thing you finish knowing no one will ever grade it. That's the rep that actually builds you, not the one that gets a story posted over it.

Paul wrote "work heartily, as for the Lord" to slaves, not men with dream jobs. Change who you're working for and the job title stops mattering.

Pick one thing today no one will ever know about. Save this for when you need the reminder.

#faith #discipline #godlyman #christianmen #worklikeChrist
